title: Chapter 13 – Kṣetra-Kṣetrajña Vibhāga Yoga (The Yoga of the Field and the Knower of the Field)
subtitle: Yoga of the Field and Its Knower

verses.title: 13.1 prakritim purusham
verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञमेव च ।
एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामि ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं च केशव ॥ १३-१॥
verses.roman:
arjuna uvāca
prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva kṣetraṃ kṣetrajñameva ca
etadveditumicchāmi jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ ca keśava 13-1
verses.colloquial:
arjuna uvaacha
prakritim purusham chaiva kshetram kshetrajnam eva cha
etat veditum icchaami jnaanam jneyam cha keshava 13-1
verses.translation_reworded: Arjuna said: O Keshava, I want to understand Prakriti (Matter) and Purusha (Spirit), as well as the Kshetra (the Field) and the Kshetrajna (the Knower of the Field), and knowledge and that which should be known.

verses.title: 13.2 idam shariram kaunteya
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
इदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते ।
एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः ॥ १३-२॥
verses.roman:
śrībhagavānuvāca
idaṃ śarīraṃ kaunteya kṣetramityabhidhīyate
etadyo vetti taṃ prāhuḥ kṣetrajña iti tadvidaḥ 13-2
verses.colloquial:
shrii bhagavaan uvaacha
idam shariiram kaunteya kshetram iti abhidhiiyate
etad yo vetti tam praahuh kshetrajna iti tadvidah 13-2
verses.translation_reworded: The Blessed Lord said: This body, O Kaunteya, is called the Kshetra (the Field), and the one who knows it is called the Kshetrajna (the Knower of the Field) by those who understand these two, that is, by the sages.

verses.title: 13.3 kshetra-jnam chapi
verses.sanskrit:
क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत ।
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम ॥ १३-३॥
verses.roman:
kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhi sarvakṣetreṣu bhārata
kṣetrakṣetrajñayorjñānaṃ yattajjñānaṃ mataṃ mama 13-3
verses.colloquial:
kshetrajnam chaapi maam viddhi sarva kshetreshu bhaarata
kshetra kshetrajnayoh jnaanam yat tat jnaanam matam mama 13-3
verses.translation_reworded: Understand that I am the Knower of the Field in every Field, O Bharata. In My view, knowledge of the Field together with knowledge of the Knower of the Field is true Knowledge.

verses.title: 13.4 tat kshetram yach
verses.sanskrit:
तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक्च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत् ।
स च यो यत्प्रभावश्च तत्समासेन मे श‍ृणु ॥ १३-४॥
verses.roman:
tatkṣetraṃ yacca yādṛkca yadvikāri yataśca yat
sa ca yo yatprabhāvaśca tatsamāsena me śṛṇu 13-4
verses.colloquial:
tat kshetram yaccha yaadrik cha yad vikaari yatash cha yat
sa cha yo yat prabhaavash cha tat samaasena me shrinu 13-4
verses.translation_reworded: What the Field is, what its nature is, what changes it undergoes, where it comes from, and also who He is and what His powers are: hear all this from Me in brief.

verses.title: 13.5 rishibhir bahudha
verses.sanskrit:
ऋषिभिर्बहुधा गीतं छन्दोभिर्विविधैः पृथक् ।
ब्रह्मसूत्रपदैश्चैव हेतुमद्भिर्विनिश्चितैः ॥ १३-५॥
verses.roman:
ṛṣibhirbahudhā gītaṃ chandobhirvividhaiḥ pṛthak
brahmasūtrapadaiścaiva hetumadbhirviniścitaiḥ 13-5
verses.colloquial:
rishibhir bahudhaa giitam chandobhir vividhaih prithak
brahma suutra padaish chaiva hetumadbhir vinishchitaih 13-5
verses.translation_reworded: The rishis have described this (the Field and its Knower) in many ways, in a variety of distinct hymns and also in the reasoned, conclusive passages that point to Brahman.

verses.title: 13.6 maha-bhutany ahankaro
verses.sanskrit:
महाभूतान्यहङ्कारो बुद्धिरव्यक्तमेव च ।
इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च पञ्च चेन्द्रियगोचराः ॥ १३-६॥
verses.roman:
mahābhūtānyahaṅkāro buddhiravyaktameva ca
indriyāṇi daśaikaṃ ca pañca cendriyagocarāḥ 13-6
verses.colloquial:
mahaabhuutaani ahankaaro buddhir avyaktam eva cha
indriyaani dasha ekam cha pancha cha indriya gocharaah 13-6
verses.translation_reworded: The great elements, egoism, intellect, and the unmanifest (Moola-Prakriti), along with the ten senses, the one (the mind), and the five sense objects...

verses.title: 13.7 ichchha dveshah sukham
verses.sanskrit:
इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं सङ्घातश्चेतना धृतिः ।
एतत्क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारमुदाहृतम् ॥ १३-७॥
verses.roman:
icchā dveṣaḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṅghātaścetanā dhṛtiḥ
etatkṣetraṃ samāsena savikāramudāhṛtam 13-7
verses.colloquial:
icchaa dveshah sukham duhkham sanghaatash chetanaa dhritih
etat kshetram samaasena sa vikaaram udaahritam 13-7
verses.translation_reworded: ...desire, hatred, pleasure, pain, the aggregate (the body), intelligence, and fortitude. This is the Kshetra, briefly described along with its modifications.

verses.title: 13.8 amanitvam adambhitvam
verses.sanskrit:
अमानित्वमदम्भित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम् ।
आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः ॥ १३-८॥
verses.roman:
amānitvamadambhitvam ahiṃsā kṣāntirārjavam
ācāryopāsanaṃ śaucaṃ sthairyamātmavinigrahaḥ 13-8
verses.colloquial:
amaanitvam adambhitvam ahimsaa kshaantih aarjavam
aachaarya upaasanam shaucham sthairyam aatma vinigrahah 13-8
verses.translation_reworded: Humility, freedom from pretense, non-injury, forgiveness, honesty, service to the teacher, purity, steadiness, self-control...

verses.title: 13.9 indriyartheshu vairagyam
verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यमनहङ्कार एव च ।
जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखदोषानुदर्शनम् ॥ १३-९॥
verses.roman:
indriyārtheṣu vairāgyam anahaṅkāra eva ca
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhi duḥkhadoṣānudarśanam 13-9
verses.colloquial:
indriyaartheshu vairaagyam anahankaara eva cha
janma mrityu jaraa vyaadhi duhkha dosha anudarshanam 13-9
verses.translation_reworded: ...indifference toward the objects of the senses, absence of egoism, and seeing (or reflecting on) the misery present in birth, death, old age, sickness, and pain...

verses.title: 13.10 asaktir anabhishvangah
verses.sanskrit:
असक्तिरनभिष्वङ्गः पुत्रदारगृहादिषु ।
नित्यं च समचित्तत्वमिष्टानिष्टोपपत्तिषु ॥ १३-१०॥
verses.roman:
asaktiranabhiṣvaṅgaḥ putradāragṛhādiṣu
nityaṃ ca samacittatvamiṣṭāniṣṭopapattiṣu 13-10
verses.colloquial:
asaktih anabhishvangah putra daara griha aadishu
nityam cha samachittatvam ishtaanishta upapattishu 13-10
verses.translation_reworded: ...non-attachment; not identifying the Self with son, wife, home, and the like; and a constant evenness of mind whether life brings what is wanted or what is unwanted...

verses.title: 13.11 mayi chananya-yogena
verses.sanskrit:
मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्तिरव्यभिचारिणी ।
विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि ॥ १३-११॥
verses.roman:
mayi cānanyayogena bhaktiravyabhicāriṇī
viviktadeśasevitvam aratirjanasaṃsadi 13-11
verses.colloquial:
mayi cha ananya yogena bhaktih avyabhichaarinii
vivikta desha sevitvam aratih jana samsadi 13-11
verses.translation_reworded: ...unwavering devotion to Me through the yoga of non-separation, a preference for solitary places, and a dislike of crowds of people...

verses.title: 13.12 adhyatma-jnana-nityatvam
verses.sanskrit:
अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम् ।
एतज्ज्ञानमिति प्रोक्तमज्ञानं यदतोऽन्यथा ॥ १३-१२॥
verses.roman:
adhyātmajñānanityatvaṃ tattvajñānārthadarśanam
etajjñānamiti proktamajñānaṃ yadato'nyathā 13-12
verses.colloquial:
adhyaatma jnaana nityatvam tattva jnaana artha darshanam
etad jnaanam iti proktam ajnaanam yad ato'nyathaa 13-12
verses.translation_reworded: ...steady pursuit of Self-knowledge, and insight into the goal of true knowledge. All this is declared to be knowledge; whatever opposes it is ignorance.

verses.title: 13.13 jneyam yat tat
verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वामृतमश्नुते ।
अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते ॥ १३-१३॥
verses.roman:
jñeyaṃ yattatpravakṣyāmi yajjñātvāmṛtamaśnute
anādimatparaṃ brahma na sattannāsaducyate 13-13
verses.colloquial:
jneyam yat tat pravakshyaami yat jnaatvaa amritam ashnute
anaadimat param brahma na sat tat na asat uchyate 13-13
verses.translation_reworded: I will now describe that which must be known, by knowing which one reaches Immortality: the beginningless Supreme Brahman, which is said to be neither being nor non-being.

verses.title: 13.14 sarvatah pani-padam
verses.sanskrit:
सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् ।
सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति ॥ १३-१४॥
verses.roman:
sarvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ tatsarvato'kṣiśiromukham
sarvataḥ śrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati 13-14
verses.colloquial:
sarvatah paanipaadam tat sarvatah akshi shirah mukham
sarvatah shruti malloke sarvam aavritya tishthati 13-14
verses.translation_reworded: With hands and feet on every side, with eyes, heads, and mouths on every side, with ears on every side, He dwells in the world, enveloping everything.

verses.title: 13.15 sarvendriya-gunabhasam
verses.sanskrit:
सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम् ।
असक्तं सर्वभृच्चैव निर्गुणं गुणभोक्तृ च ॥ १३-१५॥
verses.roman:
sarvendriyaguṇābhāsaṃ sarvendriyavivarjitam
asaktaṃ sarvabhṛccaiva nirguṇaṃ guṇabhoktṛ ca 13-15
verses.colloquial:
sarva indriya guna aabhaasam sarva indriya vivarjitam
asaktam sarva bhrit cha eva nirgunam guna bhoktri cha 13-15
verses.translation_reworded: He shines through the functions of all the senses, yet He has no senses. He is unattached, yet He sustains everything. He has no qualities, yet He experiences them...

verses.title: 13.16 bahir antash cha
verses.sanskrit:
बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च ।
सूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत् ॥ १३-१६॥
verses.roman:
bahirantaśca bhūtānāmacaraṃ carameva ca
sūkṣmatvāttadavijñeyaṃ dūrasthaṃ cāntike ca tat 13-16
verses.colloquial:
bahir antashcha bhuutaanaam acharam charam eva cha
suukshmatvaat tad avijneyam duurastham cha antike cha tat 13-16
verses.translation_reworded: ...That is outside and inside all beings, both the unmoving and the moving. Because It is so subtle, It cannot be known; It is both far away and very near.

verses.title: 13.17 avibhaktam cha bhuteshu
verses.sanskrit:
अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम् ।
भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च ॥ १३-१७॥
verses.roman:
avibhaktaṃ ca bhūteṣu vibhaktamiva ca sthitam
bhūtabhartṛ ca tajjñeyaṃ grasiṣṇu prabhaviṣṇu ca 13-17
verses.colloquial:
avibhaktam cha bhuuteshu vibhaktam iva cha sthitam
bhuuta bhartri cha taj jneyam grasishnu prabhavishnu cha 13-17
verses.translation_reworded: Though undivided, He appears to exist as if divided among beings. That is to be known as the Sustainer of beings; He consumes them and He brings them forth.

verses.title: 13.18 jyotisham api taj
verses.sanskrit:
ज्योतिषामपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परमुच्यते ।
ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य विष्ठितम् ॥ १३-१८॥
verses.roman:
jyotiṣāmapi tajjyotistamasaḥ paramucyate
jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānagamyaṃ hṛdi sarvasya viṣṭhitam 13-18
verses.colloquial:
jyotishaam api tat jyotih tamasah param uchyate
jnaanam jneyam jnaana gamyam hridi sarvasya vishthitam 13-18
verses.translation_reworded: That (Brahman), the Light of all lights, is said to be beyond darkness. It is Knowledge itself, the Object of Knowledge, dwelling in the hearts of all, and It is reached through Knowledge.

verses.title: 13.19 iti kshetram tatha
verses.sanskrit:
इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः ।
मद्भक्त एतद्विज्ञाय मद्भावायोपपद्यते ॥ १३-१९॥
verses.roman:
iti kṣetraṃ tathā jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ coktaṃ samāsataḥ
madbhakta etadvijñāya madbhāvāyopapadyate 13-19
verses.colloquial:
iti kshetram tathaa jnaanam jneyam choktam samaasatah
mad bhakta etad vijnaaya mad bhaavaaya upapadyate 13-19
verses.translation_reworded: In this way the Field, knowledge, and the knowable have been described in brief. My devotee who understands this enters into My Being.

verses.title: 13.20 prakritim purusham
verses.sanskrit:
प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्ध्यनादी उभावपि ।
विकारांश्च गुणांश्चैव विद्धि प्रकृतिसम्भवान् ॥ १३-२०॥
verses.roman:
prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva viddhyanādī ubhāvapi
vikārāṃśca guṇāṃścaiva viddhi prakṛtisambhavān 13-20
verses.colloquial:
prakritim purusham chaiva viddhyanaadii ubhaavapi
vikaaraamshcha gunaamshchaiva viddhi prakriti sambhavaan 13-20
verses.translation_reworded: Understand that both Matter (Prakriti) and Spirit (Purusha) are without beginning, and understand too that all modifications and all qualities arise from Prakriti.

verses.title: 13.21 karya-karana-kartritve
verses.sanskrit:
कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिरुच्यते ।
पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते ॥ १३-२१॥
verses.roman:
kāryakāraṇakartṛtve hetuḥ prakṛtirucyate
puruṣaḥ sukhaduḥkhānāṃ bhoktṛtve heturucyate 13-21
verses.colloquial:
kaarya kaarana kartritve hetuh prakriti ruchyate
purushah sukha duhkhaanaam bhoktritve hetu ruchyate 13-21
verses.translation_reworded: Prakriti is said to be the cause in the production of effect and cause; Purusha is said to be the cause in the experience of pleasure and pain.

verses.title: 13.22 purushah prakriti-stho
verses.sanskrit:
पुरुषः प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्क्ते प्रकृतिजान्गुणान् ।
कारणं गुणसङ्गोऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्मसु ॥ १३-२२॥
verses.roman:
puruṣaḥ prakṛtistho hi bhuṅkte prakṛtijānguṇān
kāraṇaṃ guṇasaṅgo'sya sadasadyonijanmasu 13-22
verses.colloquial:
purushah prakritistho hi bhunkte prakritijaan gunaan
kaaranam guna sango'sya sadasad yoni janmasu 13-22
verses.translation_reworded: Purusha, dwelling in Prakriti, experiences the qualities that Prakriti produces. Attachment to these qualities is what causes his birth in good and evil wombs.

verses.title: 13.23 upadrashtanumanta cha
verses.sanskrit:
उपद्रष्टानुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः ।
परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन्पुरुषः परः ॥ १३-२३॥
verses.roman:
upadraṣṭānumantā ca bhartā bhoktā maheśvaraḥ
paramātmeti cāpyukto dehe'sminpuruṣaḥ paraḥ 13-23
verses.colloquial:
upadrashtaa anumantaa cha bhartaa bhoktaa maheshvarah
paramaatmaa iti cha api ukto dehe'smin purushah parah 13-23
verses.translation_reworded: The supreme Purusha in this body is also called the Witness, the Permitter, the Sustainer, the Enjoyer, the great Lord, and the Supreme Self.

verses.title: 13.24 ya evam vetti purusham
verses.sanskrit:
य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैः सह ।
सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि न स भूयोऽभिजायते ॥ १३-२४॥
verses.roman:
ya evaṃ vetti puruṣaṃ prakṛtiṃ ca guṇaiḥ saha
sarvathā vartamāno'pi na sa bhūyo'bhijāyate 13-24
verses.colloquial:
ya evam vetti purusham prakritim cha gunaih saha
sarvathaa vartamaanah api na sa bhuuyah abhijaayate 13-24
verses.translation_reworded: Whoever knows Purusha and Prakriti together with the qualities in this way is not born again, whatever condition of life he may be in.

verses.title: 13.25 dhyanenatmani pashyanti
verses.sanskrit:
ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति केचिदात्मानमात्मना ।
अन्ये साङ्ख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे ॥ १३-२५॥
verses.roman:
dhyānenātmani paśyanti kecidātmānamātmanā
anye sāṅkhyena yogena karmayogena cāpare 13-25
verses.colloquial:
dhyaanenaatmani pashyanti kechid aatmaanam aatmanaa
anye saankhyena yogena karma yogena cha apare 13-25
verses.translation_reworded: Some perceive the Self in the Self by the Self through meditation; others through the yoga of Knowledge (Sankhya Yoga); and others through Karma Yoga.

verses.title: 13.26 anye tv evam ajanantah
verses.sanskrit:
अन्ये त्वेवमजानन्तः श्रुत्वान्येभ्य उपासते ।
तेऽपि चातितरन्त्येव मृत्युं श्रुतिपरायणाः ॥ १३-२६॥
verses.roman:
anye tvevamajānantaḥ śrutvānyebhya upāsate
te'pi cātitarantyeva mṛtyuṃ śrutiparāyaṇāḥ 13-26
verses.colloquial:
anye tu evam ajaanantah shrutvaa anyebhya upaasate
te'pi cha atitaranti eva mrityum shruti paraayanaah 13-26
verses.translation_reworded: Still others, not knowing this themselves, worship after hearing of it from others. They too pass beyond death, provided they hold what they have heard as their Supreme Refuge.

verses.title: 13.27 yavat sanjayate kinchit
verses.sanskrit:
यावत्सञ्जायते किञ्चित्सत्त्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम् ।
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञसंयोगात्तद्विद्धि भरतर्षभ ॥ १३-२७॥
verses.roman:
yāvatsañjāyate kiñcitsattvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam
kṣetrakṣetrajñasaṃyogāttadviddhi bharatarṣabha 13-27
verses.colloquial:
yaavat sanjaayate kinchit sattvam sthaavara jangamam
kshetra kshetrajna samyogaat tad viddhi bharatarshabha 13-27
verses.translation_reworded: Whenever any being comes into existence, whether unmoving or moving, know, O best of the Bharatas, that it arises from the union of the Field and the Knower of the Field.

verses.title: 13.28 samam sarveshu bhuteshu
verses.sanskrit:
समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम् ।
विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति ॥ १३-२८॥
verses.roman:
samaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tiṣṭhantaṃ parameśvaram
vinaśyatsvavinaśyantaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati 13-28
verses.colloquial:
samam sarveshu bhuuteshu tishthantam parameshvaram
vinashyat sva vinashyantam yah pashyati sa pashyati 13-28
verses.translation_reworded: The one who truly sees is the one who sees the Supreme Lord present equally in all beings, the imperishable within the perishable.

verses.title: 13.29 samam pashyan hi
verses.sanskrit:
समं पश्यन्हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम् ।
न हिनस्त्यात्मनात्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥ १३-२९॥
verses.roman:
samaṃ paśyanhi sarvatra samavasthitamīśvaram
na hinastyātmanātmānaṃ tato yāti parāṃ gatim 13-29
verses.colloquial:
samam pashyan hi sarvatra samavasthitam iishvaram
na hinasti aatmanaa aatmaanam tato yaati paraam gatim 13-29
verses.translation_reworded: Indeed, whoever sees the same Lord dwelling equally everywhere does not harm the Self by the self, and so reaches the Highest Goal.

verses.title: 13.30 prakrityaiva cha
verses.sanskrit:
प्रकृत्यैव च कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि सर्वशः ।
यः पश्यति तथात्मानमकर्तारं स पश्यति ॥ १३-३०॥
verses.roman:
prakṛtyaiva ca karmāṇi kriyamāṇāni sarvaśaḥ
yaḥ paśyati tathātmānamakartāraṃ sa paśyati 13-30
verses.colloquial:
prakrityaiva cha karmaani kriyamaanaani sarvashah
yah pashyati tathaatmaanam akartaaram sa pashyati 13-30
verses.translation_reworded: The one who truly sees is the one who sees that all actions are performed by Prakriti alone, and that the Self does not act.

verses.title: 13.31 yada bhuta-prithag-bhavam
verses.sanskrit:
यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति ।
तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा ॥ १३-३१॥
verses.roman:
yadā bhūtapṛthagbhāvam ekasthamanupaśyati
tata eva ca vistāraṃ brahma sampadyate tadā 13-31
verses.colloquial:
yadaa bhuuta prithag bhaavam eka stham anupashyati
tata eva cha vistaaram brahma sampadyate tadaa 13-31
verses.translation_reworded: When a person sees the whole variety of beings as resting in the One and spreading out from that One alone, he then becomes Brahman.

verses.title: 13.32 anaditvan nirgunatvat
verses.sanskrit:
अनादित्वान्निर्गुणत्वात्परमात्मायमव्ययः ।
शरीरस्थोऽपि कौन्तेय न करोति न लिप्यते ॥ १३-३२॥
verses.roman:
anāditvānnirguṇatvāt paramātmāyamavyayaḥ
śarīrastho'pi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate 13-32
verses.colloquial:
anaaditvaan nirgunatvaat paramaatmaa ayam avyayah
shariirasthah api kaunteya na karoti na lipyate 13-32
verses.translation_reworded: Because It has no beginning and no qualities, the Supreme Self, the Imperishable, neither acts nor is stained, O Kaunteya, even though It dwells in the body.

verses.title: 13.33 yatha sarva-gatam
verses.sanskrit:
यथा सर्वगतं सौक्ष्म्यादाकाशं नोपलिप्यते ।
सर्वत्रावस्थितो देहे तथात्मा नोपलिप्यते ॥ १३-३३॥
verses.roman:
yathā sarvagataṃ saukṣmyādākāśaṃ nopalipyate
sarvatrāvasthito dehe tathātmā nopalipyate 13-33
verses.colloquial:
yathaa sarva gatam saukshmyaad aakaasham nopalipyate
sarvatra avasthito dehe tathaatmaa nopalipyate 13-33
verses.translation_reworded: Just as the all-pervading ether is not stained because of its subtlety, so the Self, present everywhere in the body, is not stained.

verses.title: 13.34 yatha prakashayaty
verses.sanskrit:
यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः ।
क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत ॥ १३-३४॥
verses.roman:
yathā prakāśayatyekaḥ kṛtsnaṃ lokamimaṃ raviḥ
kṣetraṃ kṣetrī tathā kṛtsnaṃ prakāśayati bhārata 13-34
verses.colloquial:
yathaa prakaashayati ekah kritsnam lokam imam ravih
kshetram kshetrii tathaa kritsnam prakaashayati bhaarata 13-34
verses.translation_reworded: Just as the single Sun lights up the whole world, so the Lord of the Field (Paramatman) lights up the whole Field, O Bharata.

verses.title: 13.35 kshetra-kshetrajnayor
verses.sanskrit:
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेवमन्तरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा ।
भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षं च ये विदुर्यान्ति ते परम् ॥ १३-३५॥ 

ॐ तत्सदिति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु
ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञविभागयोगो नाम त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः ॥ १३॥
verses.roman:
kṣetrakṣetrajñayorevam antaraṃ jñānacakṣuṣā
bhūtaprakṛtimokṣaṃ ca ye viduryānti te param 13-35

oṃ tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu
brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde
kṣetrakṣetrajñavibhāgayogo nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ 13
verses.colloquial:
kshetra kshetrajnayor evam antaram jnaana chakshushaa
bhuuta prakriti moksham cha ye vidur yaanti te param

om tat sat iti shriimad bhagavad giitaa suupanishatsu
brahma vidyaayaam yoga shaastre shrii krishna arjuna samvaade
kshetra kshetrajna vibhaaga yogo naama trayodasho'dhyaayah 13
verses.translation_reworded:
Those who, with the eye of wisdom, come to understand the difference between the Field and the Knower of the Field, and understand how beings are freed from Prakriti, reach the Supreme.

So ends the thirteenth discourse, called "The Yoga of the Field and the Knower of the Field," in the Upanishads of the glorious Bhagavad Gita, the science of the Eternal, the scripture of Yoga, the dialogue between Sri Krishna and Arjuna.
